filter_tool1_lines: filter Turk tool1 lines to keep only those matching training dataset phrases and node types
filter_tool2_lines: filter Turk tool2 lines to keep only those with matching chat, tag, and node type criteria
build_tree_inserts_dict: build a dictionary mapping chat commands to their tree insertions parsed from tab-separated lines
postprocess_tree: postprocess a Turk tool generated tree to convert action types and format for model datasets
update_tree_spans: update tree span indices by a given shift amount and reformat Turk-style spans to dataset format
